svg.title: Live experiment: a model fixes every seeded flaky test, checked by the gate
svg.desc: claude-sonnet-5-5 was given each seeded flaky test in Rowan-gne/nullcase-demo once, live, on 2026-09-28. Order-dependent: fixed on attempt 1, order failures 13 of 20 to 0 of 20. Hash order: fixed on attempt 1, 15 of 20 to 0 of 20. Timezone: attempt 1 changed the assertion and was rejected by the policy, attempt 2 broke a healthy billing test and was rejected by the suite check, attempt 3 was accepted with a review flag, 10 of 20 to 0 of 20. Concurrency: fixed on attempt 1, parallel failures 15 of 20 to 0 of 20. Timing: fixed on attempt 1, 9 of 20 to 0 of 20. Network: not attempted, because the offline sandbox makes it fail every run. In total 5 of 5 fixable tests fixed, 4 on the first attempt, 7 model calls, $0.061.
svg.text: Each seeded flaky test, once, with a live model call. The gate decides; nothing was re-run for a better result.

g.text: an autouse fixture clears the shared registry before and after every test
list(set(tags)) becomes list(dict.fromkeys(tags)), which keeps first-seen order
1: edited the assertion (policy) · 2: broke a healthy billing test · 3: made the test's today() UTC; flagged for review
each export writes its own temp file instead of one shared file
waits on the thread's event instead of a fixed 20 ms sleep
not attempted: the sandbox is offline, so it fails every run and counts as broken

text.tspan: · 4 on the first attempt · 7 model calls · $0.061 in total · 1 flagged for review

g.text: Measured 2026-09-28 in the Docker sandbox; the targets were declared before the runs. The tests were seeded by NullCase's author,
so this shows the fix loop working on known kinds of flakiness, not a success rate on real-world tests.
